meta.name: Coup (XColos)
meta.blurb: Bluff, challenge and block: each player holds two hidden role cards, and the last one with a hidden card wins.

rules:
Each player holds two hidden role cards from a 15-card deck ({copies_per_role} each of Duke, Assassin, Captain, Ambassador, Contessa) and has coins. Seat 1 starts with {first_player_start_coins} coin and every other seat with {other_player_start_coins}. Revealed cards are face up, public and permanent.

On your turn choose one action: Income (+{income_gain}; no challenge or block); Foreign Aid (+{foreign_aid_gain}; no challenge; any player may block as Duke); Coup (pay {coup_cost}; the target loses 1 influence; no challenge or block; compulsory with {forced_coup_threshold} or more coins); Tax (claims Duke, +{tax_gain}); Assassinate (claims Assassin, pay {assassinate_cost}, the target loses 1 influence; the target may block as Contessa); Steal (claims Captain, take {steal_amount} coins from the target or all they have if fewer; the target may block as Captain or Ambassador); Exchange (claims Ambassador, draw a card then return one hidden card). Costs are never refunded.

Everyone else answers at the same moment: pass, challenge (only if a role is claimed), or block where allowed. Only the first challenger, and the first blocker, in seat order after the active player count. A challenged player who holds the role reveals it, shuffles it into the deck and draws a card; the challenger loses 1 influence. Otherwise the challenged player loses 1 influence and the action fails. A block is then open to challenge by everyone but the blocker in the same way; if the block stands the action has no effect, if it fails the action goes ahead.

A player who loses one of two cards chooses which to reveal; a player who loses all hidden cards is out and their coins vanish. The last player with a hidden card wins. After {turn_cap} turns the player with the most hidden cards wins, ties go to the most coins, and a remaining tie is a draw. There is no free discussion: claims, challenges and blocks are the only communication.

value.calc: ['coup'] if players[active_seat - 1].coins >= forced_coup_threshold else ['income', 'foreign_aid', 'tax', 'steal', 'exchange'] + (['assassinate'] if players[active_seat - 1].coins >= assassinate_cost else []) + (['coup'] if players[active_seat - 1].coins >= coup_cost else [])
